topic: Integrating antennas into digital OOH screens
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the technical challenge of integrating Wi-Fi antennas into digital Out-of-Home (OOH) screens, noting that a competitor places these antennas inside the units. The goal is to replicate this solution while maintaining signal integrity.

Several potential placement methods were discussed: utilizing ventilation areas or passing signals through plexiglass screens. It was noted that an existing successful installation in the metro system in Denmark provided a working model.

Participants agreed that the specific screen material and construction type significantly impact signal performance, citing previous issues in German installations. A suggestion was made to investigate using different antenna types, such as high-gain antennas, or defining a standardized placement area (e.g., the bottom part of the screen) based on successful metro deployments.
decisions: Investigate the technical solution used for antenna integration in the metro system.
action_items: Define requirements and specifications for the integrated antenna solution.
